categories.main_business_segments: THE PACK CORPORATION operates three main business segments: Paper Processed Products (including paper bags, printed cartons, and corrugated boxes), Chemical Products (such as poly bags and tailor bags), and Other Products (including gift items, office supplies, tags, design, and promotional materials). The group consists of the parent company and eight consolidated subsidiaries, with operations spanning manufacturing, procurement, sales, research, logistics, and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced printing technologies such as flexographic, gravure, and offset rotary printing, with a focus on high value-added and functional printing. It emphasizes environmentally friendly production, including the use of water-based flexographic inks, high recycled-content papers, and the development of original eco-friendly materials in collaboration with paper manufacturers. Production is supported by integrated in-house manufacturing, automation, and continuous investment in productivity-enhancing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: THE PACK serves a diverse range of customers, primarily in the domestic Japanese market, including food manufacturers (especially for food packaging and takeout containers), retailers, logistics and e-commerce companies, specialty stores, and the tourism/hospitality sector. The company also supplies packaging solutions to overseas markets, notably through its subsidiaries in the US and China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are predominantly in Japan, with a nationwide network of factories and sales offices. It also has a presence in the United States (via The Pack America Corporation) and China (via subsidiaries in Shanghai and Changshu), serving both local and Japanese export markets. Over 90% of sales and assets are concentrated in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: THE PACK operates mainly as a midstream and downstream player in the packaging supply chain, handling the design, manufacturing, and distribution of finished packaging products to end-user industries. It sources raw materials from paper and chemical manufacturers and delivers value-added packaging solutions directly to businesses and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into growth markets such as food packaging, e-commerce, and logistics, while deepening penetration in retail. The company is heavily focused on sustainability, developing eco-friendly materials, reducing CO2 emissions, and promoting circular economy initiatives. R&D efforts target advanced printing, new packaging formats, automation, and universal design, with a strong emphasis on environmental compliance and social responsibility.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured and procured packaging products (paper and chemical-based) to business customers. The company also offers value-added services such as packaging design, logistics solutions, and assembly/packing services. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery or shipment to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: THE PACK is one of Japan’s leading packaging manufacturers, competing with other major domestic players such as Oji Holdings, Rengo, and Daio Paper, as well as specialized packaging firms. The company differentiates itself through integrated production, a broad product lineup, and a strong focus on sustainability and customer-driven solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, consolidated net sales reached 101.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 8.0 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 6.3 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by 3.8% and net profit by 11.7% year-on-year. It maintains a robust financial position, high equity ratio (over 70%), and a stable dividend policy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: THE PACK emphasizes its role as a total packaging solutions provider, offering integrated design, manufacturing, and logistics tailored to customer needs. Its competitive edge lies in eco-friendly product development, high-quality and innovative packaging, and the ability to address social and environmental challenges. The company’s commitment to sustainability, quality certifications (ISO, FSC, FSSC22000), and customer-centric service further differentiate it in the market.
